CoupleCloudInvite.title: CoupleCloudInvite
CoupleCloudInvite.description: Minimal non-sensitive invite lookup record keyed by 6-digit coupleCode. Exposes only availability status, an optional short host hint, and schema version without leaking UIDs, public keys, full names, or chain hashes.

coupleCode.description: 6-digit globally unique numeric room code matching the document ID.

status.description: Minimal invite availability state synchronized atomically with CoupleCloudRoom.

hostDisplayHint.description: Short non-identifying host hint (0-16 characters; scrubbed to empty string on tombstone).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest state transition.

CoupleCloudRoom.title: CoupleCloudRoom
CoupleCloudRoom.description: Real-time zero-knowledge E2EE bonded room connecting at most two distinct authenticated partners via a permanently unique 6-digit couple code, Host secondary confirmation, atomic head advancement, V1->V2 migration anchor, and non-identifying tombstone retirement.

coupleCode.description: 6-digit globally unique numeric room code matching the document ID.

creatorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the Host partner who created the room (immutable).

creatorName.description: Display name of the room creator (1-32 chars; scrubbed to empty string when tombstoned).

creatorPublicKey.description: Base64 X.509 SPKI ECDH P-256 public key of the Host partner (immutable while active; scrubbed to empty string when tombstoned).

partnerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the approved joining partner (must be distinct from creatorUid).

partnerName.description: Display name of the approved joining partner (0-32 chars; scrubbed to empty string when tombstoned).

partnerPublicKey.description: Base64 X.509 SPKI ECDH P-256 public key of the approved partner (immutable while active; scrubbed to empty string when tombstoned).

pendingPartnerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of a partner awaiting Host secondary confirmation (must differ from creatorUid).

pendingPartnerName.description: Display name of a partner awaiting Host secondary confirmation (0-32 characters).

pendingPartnerPublicKey.description: Base64 X.509 SPKI ECDH P-256 public key of the pending partner awaiting Host approval.

memberUids.description: Bounded list of 1 to 2 distinct Firebase Auth UIDs belonging to the bonded couple.

spiceLevel.description: Shared couple vibe/spice level synced live between both devices.

status.description: Room lifecycle state; UNPAIRED permanently retires the code.

blockCount.description: Monotonically increasing total number of blocks (advanced atomically by +1 with every /blocks create).

latestBlockHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the deterministic Genesis block or most recently committed block.

schemaVersion.description: Independent Firestore room schema version (1 = legacy, 2 = atomic V2 with previousHash and clientTurnId).

migrationAnchorHash.description: Last verified V1 room head hash recorded when a legacy V1 room lazily upgrades to V2 without rewriting legacy history.

migrationAnchorIndex.description: Block index at which V2 continuity begins after a V1->V2 room upgrade.

tombstoned.description: True when personal names and public keys have been permanently scrubbed during account deletion while preserving code non-reuse.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set on room creation (immutable).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set on every room update.

CoupleEncryptedBlock.title: CoupleEncryptedBlock
CoupleEncryptedBlock.description: Immutable, append-only, non-deletable ECDH-P256 + HKDF-SHA256 + AES-256-GCM + Proof-of-Work blockchain packet committed atomically with room head advancement.

senderUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the sender (must match request.auth.uid).

senderName.description: Sanitized display name of the sender (1-32 characters).

memberUids.description: Denormalized list of 1 to 2 bonded member UIDs for fast local security rule evaluation.

blockIndex.description: Strict sequential index matching pre-transaction room.blockCount.

actionType.description: Type of encrypted couple activity turn or lifecycle event.

previousHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the pre-transaction room.latestBlockHash (required for schemaVersion 2).

blockHash.description: Proof-of-Work SHA-256 block hash matching document ID blockId.

schemaVersion.description: Block schema version (1 or 2), independent of wire cryptographic protocolVersion.

clientTurnId.description: Client-generated unique turn UUID for idempotent delivery and primary replay protection.

encryptedPacket.description: Zero-knowledge ECDH + AES-256-GCM + HMAC-SHA256 encrypted KRIMOON:BCHAIN: ciphertext envelope.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on block creation.

/coupleInvites/{coupleCode}.description: Minimal non-sensitive invite availability index keyed by 6-digit coupleCode.

/coupleRooms/{coupleCode}.description: Root collection of permanently unique 2-partner couple rooms keyed by 6-digit coupleCode; strictly member/pending-scoped.

/coupleRooms/{coupleCode}/blocks/{blockI.description: Immutable, non-deletable append-only stream of zero-knowledge encrypted blockchain move envelopes keyed by blockHash.
